summary: Merge Gateway routes supported LLMs through one API with routing, spend caps and security. Pro is pay-as-you-go at LLM cost plus a 5% fee and requires a credit card. An active Pro subscription receives $10 in complimentary credits on the 1st of each month; unused credits expire at month end with no rollover or cash value. Review spending controls before use: the $10 allowance is not a promise that the card-funded account automatically stops billing at $10.
claim_steps: Choose the Pro plan, which requires a credit card and charges LLM cost plus a 5% fee on a pay-as-you-go basis.
Maintain an active Pro subscription to receive $10 in complimentary credits on the 1st of each month; unused credits expire at month end, do not roll over and have no cash value.
Review and configure spending controls before making requests via gateway.merge.dev/v1. Do not assume the account automatically stops or prevents paid usage once the $10 allowance is consumed.
